settings.label: Homes for our craft: the UK, India and Dubai
Set, finished and checked by hand

settings.title: The Eden Raine collection
settings.text: Fine jewellery that reflects timeless elegance - handmade craftsmanship and the precision of CAD technology, so each piece is unique, high quality and made to last.

settings.title: Craft and precision
settings.text: From the first sketch to the final polish, every step is a blend of artistry and innovation - traditional handmade technique with the precision of CAD.

settings.title: We care
settings.text: Every piece we create has meaning, and hearing your stories keeps us crafting with love. If there is ever an issue, we are here to put it right.

settings.title: The sketch
settings.text: Every piece starts as a drawing: the stone, the setting and the proportions, settled before anything is made.

settings.title: The CAD
settings.text: The drawing becomes a precise three-dimensional model, so every millimetre is right before a single gram of gold is cut.

settings.title: The making
settings.text: Skilled makers in our workshop build the piece by hand, the way the trade has done it in our family since 1957.

settings.title: The setting
settings.text: Stone setters place each stone by hand and check it twice, because a setting is what keeps a piece safe for a lifetime.

settings.title: The polish
settings.text: A final hand polish and a last inspection, then your piece is packed and sent to you.

settings.title: Designed in the UK, made by hands we know
settings.text: As Eden Raine has grown, so has our team. Our designs are created in the UK, and our production is brought to life by skilled artisans in our workshop in India and our trusted partners in Dubai. From expert makers to stone setters, each person brings their own craft to make sure every piece meets the same standard.

settings.title: A family tradition, still being written
settings.text: With decades of experience and a commitment to quality, we keep innovating - combining our family's rich tradition with new designs and techniques. We look forward to creating more timeless, handmade jewellery that holds a special place in your life.

settings.hero_text: A family of jewellers since 1957, and a house named after a daughter. Fine jewellery made by hand, designed in the UK.
settings.story_heading: Jewellery has always been more than a passion for me
settings.story_text:
It is part of my family's legacy. Growing up in a family of jewellers since 1957, I was surrounded by the art of creating timeless pieces. But when my daughter, Eden, was born, she became my true inspiration to build something special. I wanted to design jewellery that connects people to their cherished memories and moments, just as I feel connected to her.

That is how Eden Raine was born. We combine traditional handmade techniques with modern CAD design, ensuring that each piece is hand crafted with precision and care. From the initial sketch to the final polish, every step of our process is a blend of artistry and innovation.
settings.pillars_heading: Made by hand, drawn by CAD
settings.pillars_text: Three things we are asked about most - what we make, how it is made, and what happens afterwards.
settings.cta_text: Our team can help you choose the right stone, setting and size, and answer anything you want to know before you buy.
